newsitem.title: USA: Sawtek files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Sawtek files for stock offering.

text.p: Sawtek Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday for an offering of 2.5 million shares of common stock, including 2.2 million that are being offered by current shareholders.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for capital expenditures and general corporate purposes, including working capital, the company said.
Underwriters Hambrecht & Quist, Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Raymond James & Associates Inc have been offered an overallotment option of an additional 375,000 shares, it said.
